title: Explicit factors for refinement projection pasting
statement: Record the actual finite and simultaneous-system maps in the refinement projection calculation: gamma inserts the canonical identity pushforward and applies the proper/open mate, comp is the conjugate proper compositor followed by the refinement equality, delta is the open tensor comparison followed by the compactification pullback comparison, and inner is proper projection along the refinement followed by the inverse pullback compositor. Local is the tensor equation at the inner square; Composition is projection compatibility with the outer proper compositor. The definitions retain every identity and equality transport. The output tensor has its actual first-variable action, curried at finite coefficients and uncurried for systems, together with its functoriality equation. Record also the native compactification projection components and their proved equations as outer projection followed by the image of delta; the categorical pasting theorem is available directly with these native components.
